title: P0005 Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit/Open
content:
P0005 Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit/Open
OBD-II Trouble Code Technical Description
Fuel Shutoff Valve "A" Control Circuit/Open
What does that mean?
The P0005 DTC code is generic, so that means it applies to all makes of vehicles. It's a very rarely seen DTC.
Symptoms
Symptoms of a P0005 DTC will include MIL (Malfunction indicator lamp) illumination, although there may be other symptoms.
Potential Causes
Well there is little to no good information on this code. The "Fuel Shutoff Valve "A" Control Circuit/Open" indicates it may be an open circuit in the electrical system pertaining to the fuel shutoff valve control.
Possible Solutions
Please consult a factory service manual for more specific troubleshooting steps.
